title: fix: omit the implicit simple-text seed
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Remove the default seed from simple-text requests so Responses-backed models no longer reject an otherwise ordinary request.
- Preserve explicit seeds, including zero and the -1 compatibility mapping. Explicit unsupported seeds still return 400.
- Leave image seeds and request-based cache keys unchanged; document the optional text seed in the source schema.
- Tests: 49 request, Responses-adapter, and text-cache tests; gen typecheck passes.

gist.headline: The seed knows when to sit out
gist.blurb: Simple text requests now arrive without an uninvited default seed tucked into their pollen basket. Responses-backed models can get on with the ordinary request they were asked for.
gist.summary: Simple-text requests now omit the implicit default seed for Responses-backed models, while preserving explicit seeds including 0 and the -1 compatibility mapping.
gist.impact: Ordinary text requests work with Responses-backed models again, and developers retain explicit seed control with unsupported explicit seeds still returning a clear 400 response.
gist.visual_concept: Polli tends a cozy text-message garden beside a retro terminal, gently removing an unwanted seed from a plain chat request while clearly labeled explicit seeds, including 0 and -1, remain safely planted. Small code-plants and a calm CRT monitor represent compatible Responses-backed text generation.
